import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    L=np.log(eps); p=params
    return (p[0]/eps + p[1]*T + p[2]*T**2 + p[3]*T**2*L + p[4]*T**2*L**2 + p[5]*T**2*L/eps
            + p[6]*T**2.5 + p[7]*T**2.5*L**2 + p[8]*T**2.5*L/eps + p[9]*T**3)
